Q0244

“During the time men live without a common Power to keep them…” — Thomas Hobbes (Leviathan XIII)

Verified English quotation. Primary source: Leviathan XIII. Theme: power.

Quotes / Thomas Hobbes / Q0244

English

During the time men live without a common Power to keep them all in awe, they are in that condition which is called War.
Thinker Thomas Hobbes
School Social Contract Theory
Source Leviathan XIII
Theme Power
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Leviathan XIII, within the Social Contract Theory tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of power, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Thomas Hobbes's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
